URL: https://www.iranintl.com/en/202611234259
Iran International, 23 Nov 2026

Ebrahim Azizi said Iran had no geographical limits on its response to threats and would respond to any threat, wherever it arose, in a future conflict.

He warned that the United States could not damage Iran and then leave the region without paying a price. Renewed military action by the US and Israel, he said, would accelerate their departure from the region.

Azizi also said a bill to withdraw from the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty was ready. “Whenever the country reaches a decision, the bill will be passed as quickly as possible,” he said.
